actions.government_body: City of Morris / Tract (posted project materials)
actions.result_status: The City maintains a data-center resource page for the proposed Morris Data Center. The City-posted FAQ describes a future 340-acre project bordered by Route 6 on the north, Gun Club Road to the west, and a ComEd transmission corridor to the east, and says detailed site plans must be reviewed and approved by the Development Review Committee before construction or building permits.
actions.access_caveat: FAQ is a Tract letterhead document posted by the City; no permit database record was located.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms location and pre-permit sequencing; keeps the project below construction status.

actions.result_status: Tract announced acquisition of a 343-acre Morris land parcel, a planned 2.9 million-square-foot/1GW campus, an executed ComEd Transmission Security Agreement, initial energization targeted for June 2028, and full 1GW load ramp targeted by 2032; these are company/projected statements and do not establish a building permit or construction start.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; city resource page does not by itself validate every company-described entitlement.
actions.evidence_note: Capacity, acreage, square footage, and projected power schedule only.

actions.result_status: FERC Commissioner Chang's concurrence for docket ER26-1031 states that the Commission's order accepted the Transmission Security Agreement between Commonwealth Edison Company and Grundy County Power NR I, LLC under the Mobile-Sierra framework.
actions.access_caveat: The concurrence confirms FERC acceptance and also notes that FERC did not independently assess every TSA term for customer-cost protection.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms grid/TSA regulatory milestone; does not mean the data-center campus is energized or under construction.

capacity_note: Planned full-buildout load, from Tract's January 15, 2026 announcement and City-posted project materials; not energized capacity.

contradictions.details: City-posted FAQ says 340 acres; Tract's announcement says 343 acres; City ordinance/search metadata references 384 acres/344 acres in related agreement descriptions. Treat acreage as approximate and agreement-boundary-dependent until parcel exhibits are OCR-reviewed.

FERC's official concurrence for ER26-1031 is dated March 10, 2026; Tract's April 15, 2026 announcement says the TSA was approved and City-posted presentation describes FERC approval in April 2026. Use March 10, 2026 for the official FERC action and April 15, 2026 for Tract's announcement.
